display_name: 46. FR 공간 왜곡 지표의 축소 해상도 타당성 검증
question: Does the repository FR spatial index D_s (DLPan-Toolbox 1.0 definition, common/metrics.fr_metrics) rank outputs by fidelity when the truth is known?

protocol.data: RR test 20 scenes; RR PAN/LMS/MS are given to fr_metrics exactly as FR inputs (reduced-resolution QNR check); GT is used only to measure fidelity

candidates_per_scene.models: experiment 43 C0-C3 x seeds 42/43/44, without and with the experiment 45 P5 projection (24 outputs)
candidates_per_scene.blend_to_GT: (1-t) pred + t GT for C0 s42 and C2 s42, t in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75}
candidates_per_scene.blend_to_LMS: (1-t) pred + t LMS for C0 s42 and C2 s42, t in {0.25, 0.5}

protocol.fidelity: MSE, PSNR and SAM against GT (common/metrics.rr_metrics)

indices.D_lambda_K: 1 - Q2n(LMS, MTF(fused)) as DLPan D_lambda_K.m (MTF blur only, common/observation blur)

tests.T1_truth_ranking: number of scenes where D_s(GT) < mean D_s of the three C0 seeds; valid >= 15/20, conflicting <= 5/20
tests.T2_fidelity_rank: per scene Spearman(MSE vs GT, index) over all candidates, median over scenes; valid >= +0.5, conflicting <= -0.5
tests.T3_monotone_blend: scenes where the index at t=0.75 toward GT is better than at t=0 (C0 s42 and C2 s42 separately)
tests.decision: D_s conflicts with fidelity at RR if T1 conflicting AND T2 <= -0.5; consistent if T1 valid AND T2 >= +0.5; otherwise mixed. Same tests reported for D_lambda, D_lambda_K, QNR and HQNR without separate decisions

limits: Reduced-resolution check relies on the scale-invariance assumption that FR indices themselves make; it does not prove FR behaviour. QB only; exploratory test reused; MATLAB parity handled separately (PR 105).

additional_evaluation.added_after: the toolbox 1.0 run (prepare.py) was complete; the original prepare.py run and its results are unchanged

orig_paper (DLPan flag_orig_paper=1).D_lambda_orig: mean over band pairs |Q32(F_i,F_j) - Q8(MS_LR_i, MS_LR_j)|
orig_paper (DLPan flag_orig_paper=1).D_s_orig: mean over bands |Q32(F_b, PAN) - Q8(MS_LR_b, imresize(PAN, 1/4))|
orig_paper (DLPan flag_orig_paper=1).imresize: MATLAB bicubic antialias reproduced in Python (documented algorithm, not bit-verified); scikit-image resize reported as a sensitivity check

variants.Q32 / Q8: UQI averaged over non-overlapping 32x32 (full grid) or 8x8 (MS grid) blocks, common/metrics._block_uqi

additional_evaluation.candidates: identical construction to prepare.py (checked by recomputing the toolbox 1.0 indices and comparing with results/validity.json)
additional_evaluation.tests: same T1, T2, T3 and the same decision rule as prepare.py, applied to D_s_orig (decision) and to D_lambda_orig, QNR_orig (reported)
